correctness.rationale: Re-audited the corrected RESULT.md and VERIFICATION.md in /workspace/repairs/1. Kallal §2, (2.1)–(2.4), gives the split degeneration classification, injection into formal Fourier expansions and their recurrence, with the right sign; quadratic growth at both primes meets the actual eventual-adic positivity condition even when some linear exponents are negative. The two coefficient minima in each class modulo D=Nd yield the complete free integral FORMAL solution module, using independent u- and v-divisibility in R. To pass to algebraic sections, rank D follows by flat generic localization and genus-one Riemann–Roch. After clearing a denominator, a formal generator is a global section; the denominator divides that section in the completed local ring at the central identity, hence in the local ring by faithful flatness. Every vertical codimension-one point is generic in a height-one base fiber and specializes to the central identity, by flatness, irreducibility of the fibers, and the identity section. This excludes vertical poles, and the generic section excludes horizontal ones. Normality then proves the basis is algebraic. First differences of both convex quadratics give the common minimizer interval exactly, with noncoincident residues except for the two endpoints when e=f; their step multiplier is 1. Vanishing or only a single monomial on the wall cannot distinguish distinct closed torus points by section nonvanishing. In the positive chamber the sections include consecutive monomials on the closed torus. At each generic boundary the flat completed-DVR base change has the same rank argument with one valuation and at least D−1 consecutive interior monomials. Away from uv=0 the complete degree-D linear system follows by proper cohomology and base change and is very ample when D>=3. The original inference 'unramified and universally injective implies immersion' is false (include a disjoint copy of the removed origin together with A^1 minus the origin into A^1). The corrected proof only uses the separated, quasi-finite morphism and Zariski's Main Theorem, followed by ample pullback through a quasi-affine morphism. No immersion is needed.
residual_risks: The algebraicity argument uses normality of this smooth total space and the common specialization of vertical divisors, not unrestricted formal algebraization. The finite checker covers the valuation calculation, not the geometry. The ample criterion depends on the fixed Tate model and does not extend by the argument alone to general multi-parameter degenerations.

value.rationale: The two intersecting boundary divisors are the first geometric setting used in the motivating failure of generic ampleness to control total-space ampleness. The complete invariant explains exactly how those two valuations interact: inside the wall the number of central characters grows, on the wall only one persists, outside all vanish, and coinciding slopes give a linked endpoint pair. This gives an all-power test and classifies an entire natural deformation of the geometric example, not merely another counterexample or an application of the known sufficient criterion alone.
residual_risks: No classification of other cocycles, higher ranks or bases is asserted. Value is assigned to the combined complete support and threshold calculation, not the known example or positive-direction substitution in isolation.
